patterns: APPSC asks multi-statement security items (Chabahar vs Gwadar, Hambantota, Malabar-Quad, IORA) with traps planting wrong countries/funders (e.g. Gwadar 'in Yemen').
IFC-IOR is asked as statements on purpose, location (Gurugram) and administration; the key accepts Navy + Coast Guard joint administration.
Direct one-liners recur: Djibouti Code = anti-piracy, IPI = Peace pipeline, INSTC route via Iran.
Many filed PYQs here are actually world personalities/current events; the real topic PYQs are few and shallow.
App MCQs lean heavily on 2025-26 doctrines (MAHASAGAR, SHANTI, CTF-154, AIKEYME) that PYQs have not yet tested; core corridor/pipeline facts match PYQ depth.
